Map.red_line_implication: Per 02-措辞框架与红线.md, art assets (textures/icons/models) must not be extracted or republished. The map images themselves are out of scope for direct use.
Map.recommendation: Do not build a 'Map' entity table. Instead: (1) add a 'location' text field on Mission (see Mission.recommended_new_field) using only the location name, not the image; (2) the owner raised that competitor sites do show maps as content - the numeric MapEntity.Position field (see MapEntity entity) is game data, not art, and could power a self-rendered schematic/POI-marker view built by the site itself instead of displaying the extracted map texture. This is logged as a content opportunity for step 16 (page matrix) / step 25 (tools), not decided yet - see project-data/iron-nest/config.json content_opportunities.
